```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
library(rlang)
```

## Defining the hill function
```{r}

hill <- function(x, H, k, n){
  H*(x^n)/((x^n)+(k^n) + 1e-5) # added a small constant to avoid zeros on the denominator
}
```

## Phi regression
```{r}

# Blank data using the values of the non induces cases
t7_cases <- tidy_DE3_Hlim %>%
  split(list(.$strain, .$rep), drop = T)
tidy_DE3_Hlim_blanked <- lapply(t7_cases, function(x){
  blank <- x %>% 
    filter(inductor == 0) %>%
    .$phi
  
  x %>%
    group_by(inductor) %>%
    mutate(phi = phi - blank)%>%
    ungroup()
}) %>% bind_rows()

# Generate the summary table for the phi maxima
phi_table <- tidy_DE3_Hlim_blanked %>%
  filter(time < 10) %>%
  summarise(max_phi = max(phi), .by = c(strain, inductor, rep)) %>%
  group_by(strain, inductor)%>%
  summarise(phi = mean(max_phi), phi_sd = sd(max_phi), phi_se = sd(max_phi)/(n()^0.5))

# Hill function fitting
results <- lapply(split(phi_table, phi_table$strain), function(x){
  model <- nls(phi~hill(inductor, H, k, n),
               data = x,
               start = list(H = 5000, k = 10, n = 1),
               algorithm = "port", lower = c(0,0,1),
               weights = 1/((x$phi_sd)^2 + 1e-4))
  cons <- summary(model) %>% coef()
  
  phi_hat <- predict(model, tibble(inductor = 0:1000))
  tab <- tibble(strain = x$strain[1], phi_hat = phi_hat, inductor = 0:1000)
  list(constants = cons, prediction = tab)
})

# Extract results from the regression
phi_constants <- lapply(results, function(x) x$constants)
phi_curves <- lapply(results, function(x) x$prediction) %>% bind_rows()

# Plot results
phi_table %>%
  ggplot(aes(inductor, phi, shape = strain))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line(data = phi_curves, aes(inductor, phi_hat))+
  ylim(c(0,15000))

```

## Slope regression
```{r}

# Blank data using the values of the non induces cases
t7_cases <- tidy_DE3_Hlim %>%
  filter(between(time, 0, 14)) %>%
  split(list(.$strain, .$rep), drop = T)
t7_cases_blanked <- lapply(t7_cases, function(x){
  blank <- x %>% 
    filter(inductor == 0) %>%
    .$pr
  
  x %>%
    group_by(inductor) %>%
    mutate(pr = pr - blank)%>%
    ungroup()
}) %>% bind_rows()

# filter using the  time where the mean growth rate is statistically zero (alpha = 0.05), identifying the exponential phase
points <- t7_cases_blanked %>% split(list(.$strain, .$inductor, .$time), drop = T)
time_selection <- lapply(points, function(x){ 
  data <- x$gr
  test <- t.test(data, mu = 0)
  tibble(time = x$time[1], strain = x$strain[1], inductor = x$inductor[1],
         `gr = 0` = test$p.value >= 0.05)
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% arrange(strain, inductor, time) %>%
  split(list(.$strain, .$inductor), drop = T)

t_table <- lapply(time_selection, function(x){
  x[x$`gr = 0`,] %>%
    filter(time > 2) %>%
    summarise(strain = strain[1], inductor = inductor[1], t = min(time))
}) %>% bind_rows %>% arrange(strain, inductor)

tidy_DE3_exp <- t7_cases_blanked %>% left_join(t_table) %>%
  group_by(strain, inductor) %>%
  filter(time < t) %>% 
  ungroup
tidy_DE3_exp_list <- tidy_DE3_exp %>%
  split(list(.$strain, .$inductor), drop = T)

# Linear regression: production rate vs growth rate
slope_table <- lapply(tidy_DE3_exp_list, function(x){
  tab <- x %>% filter(time > 2.5, gr > 0)
  model <- lm(pr~gr, data = tab)
  tab <- summary(model) %>% coef()
  tibble(inductor = x$inductor[1], strain = x$strain[1], 
         m = tab[2,1], m_err = tab[2,2],
         b = tab[1,1], b_err = tab[1,2])
}) %>% bind_rows() %>% arrange(strain, inductor)

# Hill function fitting
results <- lapply(split(slope_table, slope_table$strain), function(x){
  model <- nls(m~hill(inductor, H, k, n),
               data = x,
               start = list(H = 5000, k = 10, n = 1),
               algorithm = "port", lower = c(0,0,1),
               weights = 1/((x$m_err)^2 + 1e-4))
  cons <- summary(model) %>% coef()
  
  m_hat <- predict(model, tibble(inductor = 0:1000))
  tab <- tibble(strain = x$strain[1], m_hat = m_hat, inductor = 0:1000)
  list(constants = cons, prediction = tab)
})

# Extract results from the regression
slope_constants <- lapply(results, function(x) x$constants)
slope_curves <- lapply(results, function(x) x$prediction) %>% bind_rows()

# Plot the results
slope_table %>%
  ggplot(aes(inductor, m, shape = strain))+
  geom_point()+
  geom_line(data = slope_curves, aes(inductor, m_hat))+
  ylim(c(0,15000))

```

## Combining both graphs

```{r}

# Data wrangling
a <- phi_table %>% mutate(mode = "phi[H]~maxima", label = "A") %>% rename(value = phi, se = phi_se) #%>% select(-phi_sd)
b <- slope_table %>% mutate(mode = "slope", label = "B") %>% rename(value = m, se = m_err)
c <- a %>% bind_rows(b) %>% mutate(mode = factor(mode))

x <- phi_curves %>% mutate(mode = "phi[H]~maxima") %>% rename(value = phi_hat)
y <- slope_curves %>% mutate(mode = "slope") %>% rename(value = m_hat)
z <- x %>% bind_rows(y) %>% mutate(mode = factor(mode))

# Final plot
strain_cols <- c("BL21 lacI"="#e60049", "BLR"="#0bb4ff", 
                 "BLR lacI"="#50e991","MG1655"="#ffa300", 
                 "MG1655 lacI"="#9b19f5")

DE3_plot <- c %>%
  filter(inductor > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(inductor/1000, value/1000, shape = strain))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = value/1000 -se/1000,
                    ymax = value/1000 + se/1000),
                linewidth = 0.2)+
  geom_point(aes(shape = strain, color = strain), size = 2)+
  geom_text(aes(0.1,13, label = label))+
  geom_line(data = z, aes(inductor/1000, value/1000, linetype = strain),
            show.legend = F)+
  facet_wrap(~mode, labeller=label_parsed)+
  xlab("IPTG concentration (mM)")+
  ylab(expression(10^3~FU~OD[600]^-1))+
  scale_y_continuous(limit = c(0,14), breaks = seq(0, 14, by = 4))+
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("MG1655" = 1, "BLR" = 0, 
                                "MG1655 lacI" = 13, "BLR lacI" = 7, 
                                "BL21 lacI" = 2), 
                     name = "Strain",
                     labels= eval(parse_exprs(c("BL21~lacI^OV", "BLR", "BLR~lacI^OV","MG1655", "MG1655~lacI^OV"))))+
  scale_color_manual(name = 'Strain',
                       values = strain_cols,
                       labels = eval(parse_exprs(c("BL21~lacI^OV", "BLR", "BLR~lacI^OV","MG1655", "MG1655~lacI^OV"))))+
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("MG1655" = 3, "BLR" = 2, 
                                   "MG1655 lacI" = 3, "BLR lacI" = 2, 
                                   "BL21 lacI" = 1), 
                        name = "Strain",
                        labels= eval(parse_exprs(c("BL21~lacI^OV", "BLR", "BLR~lacI^OV","MG1655", "MG1655~lacI^OV"))))+
  theme(plot.margin = margin(1,1,1,1, "mm"),
        #legend.position = "top",
        legend.title = element_text(size = unit(6, "mm"), face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = unit(6, "mm")),
        legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
        legend.key.size = unit(5, "mm"),
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = unit(9, "mm"), vjust = -1),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = unit(9, "mm"), vjust = 1),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = unit(8, "mm")),
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = unit(8, "mm")),
        strip.text = element_text(size = unit(8, "mm")),
        strip.background = element_rect(color = 'white'),
        aspect.ratio=1/1.5)
DE3_plot

```

## Production vs. Growth plot

```{r}

strain_cols_grid <- c("BL21 +lacI^OV"="#e60049", "BLR"="#0bb4ff", 
                 "BLR +lacI^OV"="#50e991","MG1655"="#ffa300", 
                 "MG1655 +lacI^OV"="#9b19f5")

reg <- tidy_DE3_exp %>% 
  filter(! inductor %in% c(1,10,80,125,500), gr > 0, time > 2.5) %>%
  mutate(strain=str_replace(strain,"lacI", "+lacI^OV"),
         inductor=factor(str_replace(inductor, "$", "~mu*M"), c("0~mu*M","62~mu*M","100~mu*M","250~mu*M","1000~mu*M")))

phi_reg <- phi_table %>% filter(! inductor %in% c(1,10,80,125,500)) %>%
  mutate(strain=str_replace(strain,"lacI", "+lacI^OV"),
         inductor=factor(str_replace(inductor, "$", "~mu*M"),c("0~mu*M","62~mu*M","100~mu*M","250~mu*M","1000~mu*M")))

test <- tidy_DE3_exp %>% 
  filter(! inductor %in% c(1,10,80,125,500), gr > 0) %>%
  mutate(strain=str_replace(strain,"lacI", "+lacI^OV"),
         inductor=factor(str_replace(inductor, "$", "~mu*M"), c("0~mu*M","62~mu*M","100~mu*M","250~mu*M","1000~mu*M")))

slope_grid <- reg %>% 
  filter(! inductor %in% c(1,80,125,500), gr > 0)%>%
  ggplot(aes(gr,pr/1000))+
  theme_classic()+
  geom_point(data = test, aes(gr,pr/1000), shape = 20, size = 1, color = "gray")+
  geom_point(aes(color = strain), shape = 20, size = 1.5, show.legend = F)+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black",fullrange = T,
              linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.8)+
  geom_abline(data = phi_reg,
              aes(slope = phi/1000, intercept = 0), color = "blue")+
  facet_grid(strain~inductor, labeller=label_parsed, switch = "y")+
  scale_color_manual(name = 'Strain',
                       values = strain_cols_grid,
                       labels = eval(parse_exprs(c("BL21~lacI^OV", "BLR", "BLR~lacI^OV","MG1655", "MG1655~lacI^OV"))))+
  ylim(c(0,7))+
  ylab(expression(Production~rate~(10^3*FU~OD[600]^-1*h^-1)))+
  xlab(expression(Growth~rate~(h^-1)))+
  theme(plot.margin = margin(2,2,2,2, "mm"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = unit(9, "mm")),
        strip.placement = "outside",
        axis.title.x = element_text(size = unit(9, "mm"), vjust = -1),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = unit(9, "mm"), vjust = 2),
        axis.text.x = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank())+
  theme(aspect.ratio=1/1)
slope_grid
```
